claims.statement: As the number of stores grows, existing stores will generate enough capital so that the company does not need to keep borrowing.
claims.quote: and as the number of stores grows, we believe in next two-three years, the existing stores will generate enough capital for us to not keep on borrowing anymore.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: The existing store count should be able to generate a sufficient amount of capital needed for expansion.
claims.quote: our understanding is that our existing store count itself should be able to generate sufficient amount of capital that we need for expansion.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: There is no plan at this point to have a full-fledged fresh portfolio in DMart stores.
claims.quote: is there a plan to have a full-fledged fresh portfolio in DMart stores at this point of time? No.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: The company expects to deliver the mentioned LFL growth rate in the coming financial year.
claims.quote: what we are at this point of time saying is that in the coming financial year, we see that this is something which is, possible for us to deliver.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: The company intends to prove its 6-hour delivery model in 11 cities before taking it further up.
claims.quote: our approach would be to make sure that this 6-hour delivery model, we are able to prove in these 11 cities and then once we are able to do that, then we will take it further up.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: The company believes it will be reasonably successful with the DMart Ready model once proven in 11 cities and will expand it further in the future.
claims.quote: if I look at, what we are intending to do with the DMart Ready, we believe that we will be reasonably successful on this model once we have proven it in these 11 cities. And so, we will want to actually in the future expand this even further.
claims.speaker: management

facts.statement: The company currently has 165 pickup points for DMart Ready.
Land gets capitalized as soon as the registration is done.
facts.quote: the land gets capitalized as soon as the registration is done.

facts.statement: All stores opened in the last quarter were fully operational in Q1.
facts.quote: all the stores that we opened in last quarter were fully operational in Q1.

facts.statement: The bulk of the DMart Ready business comes from 11 cities.
facts.quote: in these 11 cities where the bulk of our business comes from

facts.statement: The company does not collect customer data in offline stores to maintain simplicity and avoid a complex or time-consuming checkout experience.
facts.quote: Offline, we do not, collect the data because I think, one of the values that this organization is built around is simplicity.
